Metadata.title: Vahti AI
Metadata.description: AI receptionist platform for healthcare clinics in Finland.

hero.title: Never miss a patient again.
hero.subtitle: Vahti AI answers every call, message and chat around the clock — in Finnish and English. It qualifies leads, books appointments and keeps your calendar full.

features.title: What we do
features.subtitle: One AI receptionist that handles the whole enquiry, from first contact to booking.

ForClinics.title: Every unanswered enquiry is a lost patient.
ForClinics.subtitle: Vahti AI replies in seconds, follows up on its own and fills the calendar — so you can focus on care.
ForClinics.painSubtitle: The four most common reasons enquiries don't turn into bookings.
ForClinics.pain1Desc: A patient who fills in a form or calls expects an answer in minutes — not the next business day. By then they've booked somewhere else.
ForClinics.pain2Desc: The first message goes out, but the second and third never do. Most bookings happen on the 2nd–4th contact.
ForClinics.pain3Desc: Without reminders, some patients don't show. An empty chair costs as much as a booked one.
ForClinics.pain4Desc: There are hundreds of contacts in the CRM who once asked about a price. Nobody has time to reach out again.
ForClinics.howSubtitle: Example: a patient asks about a dental implant on WhatsApp in the middle of the night.
ForClinics.chatPatient1: Hi, how much is a single dental implant at your clinic?
ForClinics.chatAi1: Hi! A single implant costs €1,800–2,400 depending on the bone situation. That includes the consultation, surgery and crown. We also offer interest-free instalments over 6–24 months. Would you like to book a free assessment visit?
ForClinics.chatPatient2: Yes please. Any slots on Thursday?
ForClinics.chatAi2: On Thursday 18 Sept we have 14:00 and 15:30 free. Which works better?
ForClinics.chatAi3: Done — I've booked your assessment visit for Thursday 18 Sept at 14:00. I'll send a reminder the day before. See you then!
ForClinics.chatMeta: Response time 8 seconds · 22:14 · no queue, no callback
ForClinics.proofSubtitle: Examples of what a faster reply and automatic follow-up do. Figures are illustrative.
ForClinics.proof1Quote: We used to get to form submissions only in the afternoon. Now the patient gets an answer right away, and bookings are clearly up.
ForClinics.proof1Who: Front desk lead · dental clinic, Tampere
ForClinics.proof2Quote: We didn't hire more staff. Vahti handles the routine questions and books the appointments, we treat the patients.
ForClinics.proof3Quote: Reminders 24 h and 2 h before the appointment have cut no-shows sharply. The calendar stays full.
ForClinics.faq1Q: How fast is Vahti AI up and running?
ForClinics.faq1A: Basic setup takes about 5–15 minutes: you add services and prices to the knowledge base, pick channels and languages, test the agent and publish. Connecting a phone number and WhatsApp can take 1–2 business days depending on the operator.
ForClinics.faq2A: Yes. On text channels (WhatsApp, chat) Finnish and English are included in every plan. Phone answering detects the language automatically. Swedish is included in the Business plan.
ForClinics.faq3Q: What about data protection and patient records?
ForClinics.faq3A: Data is stored within the EU. Vahti AI collects enquiry and booking details, not medical records. Review GDPR and Valvira requirements with your own data protection officer before going live.
ForClinics.faq4Q: Can it book into a real calendar?
ForClinics.faq4A: Yes. Google Calendar integration is included from the Professional plan. The agent creates the booking in the calendar once the patient has confirmed the treatment and time.
ForClinics.faq5Q: What happens when the AI can't answer?
ForClinics.faq5A: The agent says honestly that it doesn't know and directs the patient to call the clinic, or leaves a contact request for staff. Urgent matters are escalated immediately.
ForClinics.faq6A: No. Billing is monthly and you can change plan or cancel at any time.
